en.headline: 93.2 per cent of Wang Fuk Court owners sign sale agreements before deadline
en.dek: The Housing Bureau says 1850 owners from the eight blocks completed the process by Thursday, with remaining cases involving special circumstances to be handled individually.
body: The Housing Bureau said on Friday that 93.2 per cent of owners at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po had signed the Agreement for Sale and Purchase before the deadline expired on Thursday.

A total of 1850 owners from the eight buildings, Blocks A to H, signed the agreements, the bureau said in a statement. The remaining owners, about 6.8 per cent, were unable to complete the process in time due to special circumstances such as probate, bankruptcy, title disputes, cases involving mentally incapacitated persons, or owners currently outside Hong Kong.

The bureau said such situations also arise in private market transactions. The Government may consider appropriate arrangements on a case-by-case basis at its discretion, balancing empathy, reason and law, with priority given to empathy.
Officials said they would continue to follow up on the assignment procedures at full speed to complete the transfer of titles.

zh.headline: 宏福苑93.2%業主限期前簽署買賣協議
zh.dek: 房屋局指八座共1850戶業主於周四前完成簽署，餘下特殊個案將按情況酌情處理。
body: 房屋局發言人周五表示，大埔宏福苑業主簽署出售單位《買賣協議》的限期周四屆滿，八座（A至H座）共1850戶業主已簽署，佔單位總數93.2%。
發言人指，部分業主因特殊情況未能及時簽署，包括需要更多時間釐清或處理業權，例如遺囑認證、破產、業權爭議、涉及精神上無行為能力人士，或業主身處境外。私人市場買賣亦會遇到類似情況。
政府會本着情、理、法兼備並以情為先的原則，按個別情況酌情考慮作出適當安排。
房屋局表示會繼續全速跟進契約轉讓手續，完成業權轉讓。
